import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    L = np.log(A)
    s = np.sqrt(t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*s + params[3]*A + params[4]*A*L
            + params[5]*A**2 + params[6]*np.exp(-A) + params[7]*A*np.exp(-A)
            + params[8]*t*A + params[9]*s*A*L)
